items.title: ‘Resident Evil’ Reviving Fall With $53M-$60M U.S. Opening: Best Ever For Zach Cregger & Franchise – Box Office Update
items.summary: SATURDAY AM: Zach Cregger’s R-rated Resident Evil is giving the fall box office a blood transfusion with an opening that could approach $60M per rivals, this after last weekend’s less robust start of Practical Magic 2.

items.title: ‘The Other Bennet Sister’ Christmas Special Sees Mary Embark on Married Life in First Images
items.summary: BritBox have given fans of their hit Jane Austen-inspired series “The Other Bennet Sister” an early Christmas present with a first look at a new three-part special set to drop this holiday season.

items.title: White House Blocks CNN and MS NOW Journalists From Entry and Confiscates Their Badges After Donald Trump Bans Networks
items.summary: President Donald Trump doesn’t like the coverage of him by CNN, MS NOW and Politico — and as of Saturday, the White House started enforcing the president’s ban on those news organizations from accessing the facility.
